citations.quote: Gary E. Dickerson President and Chief Executive Officer, Applied Materials, Inc. Mr. Dickerson has been President of Applied Materials since 2012 and Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board of Directors since 2013.

Applied currently has ten directors. Upon the recommendation of the Governance Committee, the Board has nominated the ten individuals listed below for election at the Annual Meeting, each of whom currently serves as a director of Applied.
Highly Independent Board (9 of 10 Director nominees) and Committees
Gender Identity M F F M M M M M M M (2 of 10 director nominees identified as F)
Our annual “say-on-pay” proposals have been supported by our shareholders each year since we began providing this vote in 2011, and received 91% support in 2025.

On the record date, there were 793,721,461 shares of Applied common stock outstanding. Each share of Applied common stock is entitled to one vote for each director nominee and one vote for each of the proposals to be voted on.
